requirements.description: The immutable candidate starts with empty MySQL and Redis volumes and runs every migration.
The first empty-database start creates an administrator without manual SQL.
Bootstrap credential material is absent from repository and retained logs.
Restart without the bootstrap variable preserves the existing administrator password.
Successful and failed browser logins have the required responses, session, and login audit records.
Redis session persistence, logout invalidation, and disabled-user next-request invalidation are observed.
All browser write paths reject absent and incorrect CSRF tokens without side effects.
Every frozen user-management action is completed in a browser and audited.
Role, permission, menu, stale-version, and next-request revocation behavior is observed.
Self, last-administrator, and built-in ADMIN lockout protections are observed.
Runtime menu removal hides navigation and direct unauthorized routing reaches the 403 page.
Unauthorized buttons are hidden and direct write API requests independently return 403.
Permission uniqueness, status, and protected-baseline deletion behavior is observed.
Normal configuration is maintainable and every credential-like key class is rejected.
The release browser exercises the candidate Project surface.
Pagination, limit, keyword, status, and detail behavior is observed.
The release browser performs candidate Project create, update, and remove operations.
The official SDK performs the candidate MCP Project write workflow.
Uniqueness, validation, logical deletion, and stale-version 409 behavior is observed.
REST and MCP Project adapters are proven to share ProjectService and MCP has no Mapper dependency.
Rollback, joint success commit, and durable failed-MCP audit behavior is observed.
The release browser exercises credential lifecycle filtering without redisplaying secrets.
One-time plaintext, keyed hash, hint, scope, expiry, revocation, IP, and last-use behavior is observed.
Service-account status, role, token issuance/revocation, and immediate subject disablement are observed.
The candidate publishes multiple keys and signs with the active key.
Pre-registration, secret rotation, exact redirect validation, and disabled dynamic registration are observed.
The release browser completes Authorization Code with PKCE S256.
The official SDK calls public MCP with the user OAuth token.
Expired and revoked user access tokens are rejected.
The immutable candidate completes Client Credentials and a least-privilege MCP call.
Subject disablement and RBAC revocation invalidate the existing automation token immediately.
Both RBAC-allowed/scope-denied and scope-allowed/RBAC-denied combinations return 403.
The same PAT succeeds privately and is rejected publicly.
The public ingress hides management and operational endpoints.
Private PAT, direct service-account, and OAuth acceptance plus public long-token rejection are observed.
Both metadata documents, issuer, audience, and WWW-Authenticate are mutually consistent.
The official SDK initializes a public OAuth MCP session.
The official SDK initializes a private PAT MCP session.
The official SDK validates the exact tool list plus read, denied, invalid, missing, and unknown-tool results.
The official SDK validates all mutating Project tools and audit.list.
All seven input schemas and permission declarations match the frozen catalog.
The official SDK lists and reads the frozen system resource.
A caller without system:info is denied the resource.
The official SDK lists and obtains project.summary with hostile business text.
Hostile business content cannot change system capabilities or the tool catalog.
A non-browser official SDK Agent succeeds without Origin.
Valid and invalid Host and Origin combinations produce the frozen outcomes.
Official SDK protocol discovery returns exactly the frozen seven-tool catalog, so no SQL, shell, process, filesystem, dynamic-code, or third-party MCP-client Tool is exposed.
Both login outcomes contain every required field without password material.
Every frozen write domain records the required actor, resource, outcome, duration, and trace fields.
Official SDK Project CRUD can be correlated to MCP audit records.
Success, permission, validation, and business-failure audits contain all required identities and trace fields.
The current candidate source passes the repository secret policy.
Known runtime canaries are absent from logs, errors, audits, and database rows except one-time creation responses.
The release browser exercises the Project and operation-log pages.
The release browser exercises the account-security page.
The release browser exercises the credential-management page.
All twelve frozen management surfaces are opened and their primary actions are usable.
The release browser covers desktop Project CRUD and responsive rendering.
Desktop, 390px, loading, empty, validation, 401, 403, 409, and 500 states are observed.
Java 21, Actuator version, build version, immutable image references, and both OCI label identities match the formal release.
The isolated five-service candidate stack starts from empty named volumes.
Nginx is the only default host ingress and a complete stop/start preserves business data.
Authenticated management metrics are captured without identity labels.
MySQL loss affects readiness but not liveness and then recovers.
Redis loss affects readiness but not liveness and then recovers.
Logs, backup/restore, upgrade/rollback, and RSA rotation documentation is verified current.
The current candidate source passes the repository secret policy.
The candidate App image rejects unsafe production configuration before infrastructure startup.
The current candidate passes an externally supplied forbidden-term scan.
The caller-designated read-only reference repository is byte-state identical before and after the run.
A review confirms no copied business module or vocabulary outside the external term list.
Maven verify passes without skipped failures.
Frontend lint passes.
Frontend typecheck passes.
Frontend tests pass.
Frontend production build passes.
The fixed generator safely plans a unique Web, REST, audit, migration, permission, and MCP module without writes.
An isolated generated module passes migration, CRUD, authorization, audit, browser, and optional official-SDK MCP acceptance.
